title: Cursor Agent terminal output is truncated or garbled with Powerlevel10k or another heavy prompt
symptoms: Command output looks cut off or misformatted in Agent's terminal
The same command prints normally in a plain terminal
cause: Prompt themes such as Powerlevel9k and Powerlevel10k interfere with how Cursor captures inline terminal output for Agent.
fix: Skip the theme when the CURSOR_AGENT variable is set, so Agent sessions get a simple prompt.
affected: Cursor Agent terminal on zsh and bash, as of 2026-10
